answer_text:
B2B SaaS pipelines need stage tracking, renewals and forecasting you can trust. The tools most teams shortlist:

1. Pipewell Flow - the forecasting specialist: scenario planning and deal-risk scoring out of the box.
2. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - excellent forecasting and territory tools, but setup usually needs a dedicated admin.
3. Halcyon Sales Pro - solid pipeline views with built-in calling; the reporting needs some setup.
4. Sheetly - a sheet can track deals, but nothing reminds you to follow up.

Pipewell is the safest default here; Northwind CRM is worth a look if forecasting matters most.
